    primary_port_unlocode CHAR(5) NOT NULL,
    aeo_broker_tier VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL CHECK (
        aeo_broker_tier IN ('Advanced Certified Broker', 'General Certified Broker')
    ),
    active_poa_clients_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (active_poa_clients_count > 0)
);

-- 98. cn_packing_lists_pallet_carton_details
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_packing_lists_pallet_carton_details (
    packing_list_id VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    broker_forwarder_id VARCHAR(28) NOT NULL,
    packaging_unit_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL CHECK (
        packaging_unit_type IN (
            'Fumigated Euro Pallet ISPM-15',
            'Heavy Duty Steel Skid',
            'Export Corrugated Master Carton',
            'Reefer Insulated Wine Case',
            'Bulk Kraft Pulp Bale'
        )
    ),
    total_pallets_or_skids INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_pallets_or_skids > 0),
    total_packages_cartons INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_packages_cartons > 0),
    total_net_weight_jin NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL CHECK (total_net_weight_jin > 0),
    total_gross_weight_jin NUMERIC(14,3) NOT NULL CHECK (total_gross_weight_jin >= total_net_weight_jin),
    total_volume_cbm NUMERIC(10,3) NOT NULL CHECK (total_volume_cbm > 0),
    shipping_marks_stencil VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (invoice_no) REFERENCES cn_commercial_invoices(invoice_no),
    FOREIGN KEY (broker_forwarder_id) REFERENCES cn_freight_forwarders_nvocc_customs_brokers(broker_forwarder_id)
);

-- 99. cn_processing_trade_manuals_handbook
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_processing_trade_manuals_handbook (
    e_manual_handbook_no CHAR(12) PRIMARY KEY,
    operating_enterprise_uscc CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    supervision_mode_code CHAR(4) NOT NULL CHECK (supervision_mode_code IN ('0615', '0214', '5034', '1234')),
    imported_raw_material_hs10 CHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    exported_finished_product_hs10 CHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    unit_consumption_ratio NUMERIC(8,4) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_consumption_ratio > 0),
    bonded_duty_suspended_cny NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK (bonded_duty_suspended_cny >= 0),
    verification_writeoff_status VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL CHECK (
        verification_writeoff_status IN ('Active Open Manual', 'Verified & Written Off', 'Pending Bonded Balancing')
    ),
    FOREIGN KEY (operating_enterprise_uscc) REFERENCES cn_enterprises_manufacturers(uscc_code),
    FOREIGN KEY (zone_id) REFERENCES cn_special_economic_ftz_zones(zone_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (exported_finished_product_hs10) REFERENCES cn_hs_tariff_schedule_gacc(hs_code_10_cn)
);

-- 100. cn_gacc_aeo_mutual_recognition_registry
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_gacc_aeo_mutual_recognition_registry (
    aeo_mra_certificate_no VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    chinese_enterprise_uscc CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    eu_partner_eori_pt VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    mra_agreement_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CN-EU-AEO-MRA-2014',
    reduced_inspection_rate_pct NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (reduced_inspection_rate_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 20),
    priority_clearance_lane BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    last_gacc_reaudit_date DATE NOT NULL,
    valid_until_date DATE NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (chinese_enterprise_uscc) REFERENCES cn_enterprises_manufacturers(uscc_code)
);

-- 101. cn_export_control_dual_use_mofcom_permits
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_export_control_dual_use_mofcom_permits (
    dual_use_permit_no VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    exporter_uscc CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    gacc_entry_id_18 CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    control_list_item_code VARCHAR(25) NOT NULL,
    controlled_substance_or_tech VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    end_user_pt_eori VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    end_use_statement_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    approval_authority VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    issue_date DATE NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (exporter_uscc) REFERENCES cn_enterprises_manufacturers(uscc_code),
    FOREIGN KEY (gacc_entry_id_18) REFERENCES cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc(gacc_entry_id_18)
);

-- 102. cn_preferential_certificates_of_origin_ccpit
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_preferential_certificates_of_origin_ccpit (
    co_certificate_no VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    gacc_entry_id_18 CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    exporter_uscc CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    co_type VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL CHECK (
        co_type IN ('Non-Preferential CO CCPIT', 'GACC General Certificate of Origin', 'Macao CEPA Origin Certificate')
    ),
    origin_criterion VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL CHECK (
        origin_criterion IN ('WO - Wholly Obtained', 'PE - Produced Exclusively', 'PSR - Substantial Transformation')
    ),
    regional_value_content_pct NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (regional_value_content_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    issuing_chamber_branch VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    qr_verification_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (gacc_entry_id_18) REFERENCES cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc(gacc_entry_id_18),
    FOREIGN KEY (exporter_uscc) REFERENCES cn_enterprises_manufacturers(uscc_code)
);

-- 103. cn_customs_tariff_quotas_antidumping_mofcom
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_customs_tariff_quotas_antidumping_mofcom (
    measure_record_id VARCHAR(30) PRIMARY KEY,
    hs_code_10_cn CHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    gacc_import_id_18 CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    mofcom_announcement_no VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    measure_type VARCHAR(55) NOT NULL CHECK (
        measure_type IN (
            'EU Pork Anti-Dumping Investigation Deposit',
            'EU Brandy Provisional Security Deposit',
            'Agricultural Tariff Rate Quota TRQ',
            'MFN Standard Zero Measure'
        )
    ),
    applicable_deposit_or_quota_rate_pct NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (applicable_deposit_or_quota_rate_pct >= 0),
    security_deposit_collected_cny NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    cooperating_exporter_pt_eori VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (hs_code_10_cn) REFERENCES cn_hs_tariff_schedule_gacc(hs_code_10_cn),
    FOREIGN KEY (gacc_import_id_18) REFERENCES cn_customs_import_declarations_gacc(gacc_import_id_18)
);

-- 104. cn_customs_tax_guarantees_consolidated_bonds
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_customs_tax_guarantees_consolidated_bonds (
    guarantee_bond_no VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    enterprise_uscc CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    guarantor_bank_or_insurer VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    guarantee_mode VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CHECK (
        guarantee_mode IN ('Consolidated Monthly Taxation Bond', 'Transit Customs Bond', 'Anti-Dumping Provisional Security Bond')
    ),
    bond_limit_cny NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (bond_limit_cny > 0),
    utilized_amount_cny NUMERIC(15,2) NOT NULL CHECK (utilized_amount_cny >= 0),
    beneficiary_customs_district CHAR(4) NOT NULL,
    expiry_date DATE NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (enterprise_uscc) REFERENCES cn_enterprises_manufacturers(uscc_code)
);

-- 105. cn_advance_rulings_classification_valuation_gacc
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_advance_rulings_classification_valuation_gacc (
    ruling_decision_no VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    applicant_uscc CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    ruling_category VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL CHECK (
        ruling_category IN ('Tariff Classification HS10', 'Origin Determination', 'Customs Valuation Methodology')
    ),
    confirmed_hs_code_10_cn CHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    product_commercial_description VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    issuing_gacc_customs_house VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    effective_date DATE NOT NULL,
    valid_for_years SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
    FOREIGN KEY (applicant_uscc) REFERENCES cn_enterprises_manufacturers(uscc_code),
    FOREIGN KEY (confirmed_hs_code_10_cn) REFERENCES cn_hs_tariff_schedule_gacc(hs_code_10_cn)
);

-- 106. cn_post_clearance_audits_anti_smuggling_gacc
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_post_clearance_audits_anti_smuggling_gacc (
    pca_audit_case_no VARCHAR(32) PRIMARY KEY,
    audited_enterprise_uscc CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    target_declaration_id_18 CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    audit_bureau_division VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    audit_focus_area VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL CHECK (
        audit_focus_area IN (
            'Transfer Pricing & Royalties Valuation',
            'Export VAT Rebate Authenticity',
            'HS Code Misclassification Check',
            'CIFER Cold-Chain Traceability'
        )
    ),
    audit_outcome VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL CHECK (
        audit_outcome IN ('Compliant - No Adjustment', 'Supplementary Tax Assessed', 'Voluntary Disclosure Accepted')
    ),
    supplementary_tax_or_fine_cny NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    audit_closing_date DATE NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (audited_enterprise_uscc) REFERENCES cn_enterprises_manufacturers(uscc_code)
);

-- 107. cn_excise_consumption_tax_sta
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_excise_consumption_tax_sta (
    consumption_tax_id VARCHAR(30) PRIMARY KEY,
    gacc_import_id_18 CHAR(18) NOT NULL,
    hs_code_10_cn CHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    taxable_category_zh_en VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    ad_valorem_rate_pct NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (ad_valorem_rate_pct >= 0),
    specific_duty_per_unit_cny NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    assessed_consumption_tax_cny NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (assessed_consumption_tax_cny >= 0),
    sta_tax_receipt_no VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY (gacc_import_id_18) REFERENCES cn_customs_import_declarations_gacc(gacc_import_id_18),
    FOREIGN KEY (hs_code_10_cn) REFERENCES cn_hs_tariff_schedule_gacc(hs_code_10_cn)
);

-- 108. cn_ipr_customs_protection_recordations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cn_ipr_customs_protection_recordations (
    ipr_recordation_no VARCHAR(30) PRIMARY KEY,
    right_holder_uscc_or_eori VARCHAR(25) NOT NULL,
    brand_or_patent_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    ipr_type VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL CHECK (
        ipr_type IN ('Registered Trademark CNIPA', 'Invention Patent CNIPA', 'Geographical Indication GI Douro/Porto')
    ),
    cnipa_registration_no VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL,
    authorized_exporters_importers_list VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    border_enforcement_status VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL CHECK (
        border_enforcement_status IN ('Active Border Protection', 'Detention Triggered', 'White-Listed Authorized Channel')
    ),
    valid_until_date DATE NOT NULL
);

-- Indexes for high-performance query execution and P2 Virtual Data Integration joins
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_hs_wco6 ON cn_hs_tariff_schedule_gacc(hs_code_6_wco);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_contracts_pt_eori ON cn_b2b_commercial_contracts(portuguese_counterparty_eori);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_export_bl ON cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc(bill_of_lading_or_waybill_no);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_import_bl ON cn_customs_import_declarations_gacc(bill_of_lading_no);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_fx_uetr ON cn_fx_settlements_pboc_safe(swift_uetr_or_cips_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_fdi_pt_nif ON cn_outward_fdi_approvals_ndrc(target_pt_company_nif);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_lc_contract ON cn_letters_of_credit_ucp600_swift(contract_no_cn);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_packing_inv ON cn_packing_lists_pallet_carton_details(invoice_no);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cn_aeo_pt_eori ON cn_gacc_aeo_mutual_recognition_registry(eu_partner_eori_pt);

code_files.title: David: Esquema W3C XML Schema (XSD) dos 20 Contentores Logísticos
code_files.desc: Esquema XSD rigoroso validando os 20 contentores XML (portos, navios, B/L, comboios BRI, carga aérea, telemetria IoT, e-commerce) via xmllint.
code_files.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!--
  UNIVERSIDADE DO ALGARVE - MSc in Informatics Engineering (2026/2027)
  Course: Data Modelling and Integration (DMI) - Project P1
  Student: David Rodrigues (Subtopic: China Logistics, Belt & Road & E-Commerce)
  Source D2: Semi-Structured XML Database (BaseX XML / W3C XSD Schema)
  Validates all 12 XML Containers (Tables 53 to 64)
-->
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" elementFormDefault="qualified">

    <!-- 53. cn_seaports_terminals_xml -->
    <xs:element name="ChineseSeaportsCatalog">
        <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
                <xs:element name="PortComplex" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                    <xs:complexType>
                        <xs:sequence>
                            <xs:element name="PortName">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:attribute name="en" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="zh" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="AnnualThroughputMillionTEU" type="xs:decimal"/>
                            <xs:element name="DeepWaterTerminals">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:sequence>
                                        <xs:element name="Terminal" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                                            <xs:complexType>
                                                <xs:sequence>
                                                    <xs:element name="DirectLinerRoutesToPortugal">
                                                        <xs:complexType>
                                                            <xs:sequence>
                                                                <xs:element name="LinerService" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                                                                    <xs:complexType>
                                                                        <xs:attribute name="serviceCode" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                                        <xs:attribute name="alliance" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                                        <xs:attribute name="destinationPortPT" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                                        <xs:attribute name="transitDaysSuez" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>
                                                                        <xs:attribute name="transitDaysGoodHope" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>
                                                                    </xs:complexType>
                                                                </xs:element>
                                                            </xs:sequence>
                                                        </xs:complexType>
                                                    </xs:element>
                                                </xs:sequence>
                                                <xs:attribute name="terminalId" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="operator" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="maxDraftMeters" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="automatedAGVs" type="xs:boolean" use="required"/>
                                            </xs:complexType>
                                        </xs:element>
                                    </xs:sequence>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                        </xs:sequence>
                        <xs:attribute name="unlocode" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="customsDistrictCode" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="provinceCodeGB" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                    </xs:complexType>
                </xs:element>
            </xs:sequence>
        </xs:complexType>
    </xs:element>

    <!-- 54. cn_maritime_vessels_voyages_xml -->
    <xs:element name="MaritimeVoyagesRegistry">
        <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
                <xs:element name="MaritimeVoyage" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                    <xs:complexType>
                        <xs:sequence>
                            <xs:element name="VesselDetails">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:sequence>
                                        <xs:element name="VesselName" type="xs:string"/>
                                        <xs:element name="CarrierLine" type="xs:string"/>
                                        <xs:element name="FlagState" type="xs:string"/>
                                        <xs:element name="NominalCapacityTEU" type="xs:integer"/>
                                    </xs:sequence>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="ItineraryRotation">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:sequence>
                                        <xs:element name="PortCall" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                                            <xs:complexType>
                                                <xs:attribute name="seq" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="unlocode" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="timestampCSTorUTC" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="operation" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                            </xs:complexType>
                                        </xs:element>
                                    </xs:sequence>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="BunkerFuelAndEmissions">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:attribute name="fuelType" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="consumedMetricTons" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="voyageRoute" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                        </xs:sequence>
                        <xs:attribute name="voyageId" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="vesselImo" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="serviceLoop" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                    </xs:complexType>
                </xs:element>
            </xs:sequence>
        </xs:complexType>
    </xs:element>

    <!-- 55. cn_master_bills_of_lading_xml -->
    <xs:element name="ElectronicBillsOfLading">
        <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
                <xs:element name="BillOfLading" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                    <xs:complexType>
                        <xs:sequence>
                            <xs:element name="Parties">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:attribute name="shipperUsccOrNif" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="consigneeEoriOrUscc" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="notifyPartyTaxId" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="Routing">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:attribute name="portOfLoading" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="portOfDischarge" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="placeOfDelivery" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="vesselImo" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="ContainerizedCargoList">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:sequence>
                                        <xs:element name="Container" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                                            <xs:complexType>
                                                <xs:sequence>
                                                    <xs:element name="HSCode6WCO" type="xs:string"/>
                                                    <xs:element name="CargoDescription" type="xs:string"/>
                                                </xs:sequence>
                                                <xs:attribute name="isoNumber" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="sizeType" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="customsSealNo" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="packagesCount" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="grossWeightKg" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="volumeCbm" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
                                            </xs:complexType>
                                        </xs:element>
                                    </xs:sequence>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="FreightCharges">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:attribute name="paymentTerms" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="freightAmountUSD" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="insuranceAmountUSD" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                        </xs:sequence>
                        <xs:attribute name="blNumber" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="gaccDeclarationId18" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="invoiceNo" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="issueDate" type="xs:date" use="required"/>
                    </xs:complexType>
                </xs:element>
            </xs:sequence>
        </xs:complexType>
    </xs:element>

    <!-- 56. cn_bri_railway_consignments_xml -->
    <xs:element name="BRIRailwayConsignments">
        <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
                <xs:element name="RailConsignmentCIMSMGS" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                    <xs:complexType>
                        <xs:sequence>
                            <xs:element name="RouteCorridor">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:attribute name="originTerminalCN" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="destinationTerminalPT" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="totalDistanceKm" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="transitDays" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="BorderGaugeBreakStations">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:sequence>
                                        <xs:element name="GaugeChange" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                                            <xs:complexType>
                                                <xs:attribute name="borderCrossing" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="fromGaugeMm" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="toGaugeMm" type="xs:integer" use="required"/>
                                            </xs:complexType>
                                        </xs:element>
                                    </xs:sequence>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="WagonContainers">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:sequence>
                                        <xs:element name="RailContainer" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                                            <xs:complexType>
                                                <xs:attribute name="isoNumber" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="wagonUicNo" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="shipperUscc" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="consigneeEoriPT" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="hsCode6" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="grossWeightKg" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
                                            </xs:complexType>
                                        </xs:element>
                                    </xs:sequence>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                        </xs:sequence>
                        <xs:attribute name="cimSmgsNoteNo" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="trainBlockCode" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="gaccEntryId18" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="departureDate" type="xs:date" use="required"/>
                    </xs:complexType>
                </xs:element>
            </xs:sequence>
        </xs:complexType>
    </xs:element>

    <!-- 57. cn_air_cargo_manifests_xml -->
    <xs:element name="AirCargoManifestsIATA">
        <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
                <xs:element name="AirWaybillManifest" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                    <xs:complexType>
                        <xs:sequence>
                            <xs:element name="FlightRouting">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:attribute name="airlineName" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="flightNumber" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="originAirportIATA" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="destinationAirportIATA" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                    <xs:attribute name="departureUTC" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                            <xs:element name="ULDCargoLots">
                                <xs:complexType>
                                    <xs:sequence>
                                        <xs:element name="ULD" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                                            <xs:complexType>
                                                <xs:attribute name="uldCode" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="chargeableWeightKg" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="natureOfGoods" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                                <xs:attribute name="temperatureControlC" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                                            </xs:complexType>
                                        </xs:element>
                                    </xs:sequence>
                                </xs:complexType>
                            </xs:element>
                        </xs:sequence>
                        <xs:attribute name="masterAwb" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="gaccEntryId18" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="shipperUscc" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
                        <xs:attribute name="consigneeEoriPT" type="xs:string" use="required"/>

Description:
  Executes, prints the exact query code (SQL 3FN / XPath / Cross-Source),
  and renders real formatted data tables in the terminal for David's
  Individual Subtopic Queries (Q03, Q04) over Source D1 (38 SQL 3FN Tables)
  and Source D2 (20 XSD-Validated XML Containers) PLUS the 8 Cross-Subtopic
  Queries (Q05..Q12) integrating China and Portugal data sources.
===============================================================================
"""

import json
import sqlite3
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any

DAVID_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
AFONSO_DIR = DAVID_DIR.parent / "Afonso_Bitoque_Portugal"

DAVID_SQLITE = DAVID_DIR / "data" / "relational_db" / "china_gacc_mofcom_3nf.sqlite"
DAVID_XML_DIR = DAVID_DIR / "data" / "xml_containers"
AFONSO_RESULTS = AFONSO_DIR / "queries" / "expected_results_afonso.json"


def format_ascii_table(rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], max_col_width: int = 28, max_rows: int = 15) -> str:
    """Renders a list of dicts as a clean Unicode box table for terminal display."""
    if not rows:
        return "  (Sem registos devolvidos)\n"
    display_rows = rows[:max_rows]
    headers = list(display_rows[0].keys())
    if len(headers) > 7:
        headers = headers[:7]

    def fmt_val(v):
        if v is None:
            return "NULL"
        if isinstance(v, float):
            return f"{v:,.2f}"
        s = str(v).replace("\n", " ")
        return s[:max_col_width - 1] + "…" if len(s) > max_col_width else s

    widths = [len(h) for h in headers]
    str_rows = []
    for r in display_rows:
        sr = [fmt_val(r.get(h)) for h in headers]
        for idx, val in enumerate(sr):
            if len(val) > widths[idx]:
                widths[idx] = len(val)
        str_rows.append(sr)

    top = "  ┌─" + "─┬─".join("─" * w for w in widths) + "─┐"
    head = "  │ " + " │ ".join(h.ljust(widths[i]) for i, h in enumerate(headers)) + " │"
    sep = "  ├─" + "─┼─".join("─" * w for w in widths) + "─┤"
    bot = "  └─" + "─┴─".join("─" * w for w in widths) + "─┘"

    lines = [top, head, sep]
    for sr in str_rows:
        lines.append("  │ " + " │ ".join(sr[i].ljust(widths[i]) for i in range(len(headers))) + " │")
    lines.append(bot)
    if len(rows) > max_rows:
        lines.append(f"  ... (+{len(rows) - max_rows} registos adicionais omitidos no ecrã; todos gravados no JSON)")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def print_query_execution(q: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Prints the full query metadata, query code, and real results table to the terminal."""
    print("\n" + "━" * 116)
    print(f"🔎 [{q['query_id']}] [{q['difficulty'].upper()}] — {q['title']}")
    print(f"👤 Responsável: {q['scope']}")
    print(f"🗄️  Fontes Usadas: {', '.join(q['sources_used'])}")
    print(f"💡 Justificação: {q['justification']}")
    print("─" * 116)
    print("📜 CÓDIGO DA QUERY EXECUTADA:")
    for line in q.get("query_code", "").strip().split("\n"):
        print(f"   {line}")
    print("─" * 116)
    out_rows = q.get("output", [])
    print(f"📊 RESULTADOS REAIS OBTIDOS ({len(out_rows)} registos retornados):")
    print(format_ascii_table(out_rows))


def run_david_queries(quiet: bool = False):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(DAVID_SQLITE))
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    cur = conn.cursor()

    results = []

    # =========================================================================
    # Q3 [SIMPLE - Individual David (China: Source D1 PostgreSQL Relational)]
    # =========================================================================
    q3_sql = """SELECT e.uscc_code, e.company_name_en, e.company_name_zh, p.province_name_en,
       e.registered_capital_wan_cny, ROUND(e.registered_capital_wan_cny * 10000.0, 2) AS registered_capital_cny,
       COUNT(g.gacc_entry_id_18) AS export_shipments_to_pt,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(g.total_fob_value_cny), 0), 2) AS total_fob_exported_cny,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.rebate_amount_paid_cny), 0), 2) AS total_vat_rebate_received_cny
FROM cn_enterprises_manufacturers e
JOIN cn_provinces_prefectures_cities p ON e.admin_division_code_gb = p.admin_division_code_gb
LEFT JOIN cn_special_economic_ftz_zones z ON e.zone_id = z.zone_id
LEFT JOIN cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc g ON e.uscc_code = g.exporter_uscc
LEFT JOIN cn_vat_export_tax_rebates_sta r ON g.gacc_entry_id_18 = r.gacc_entry_id_18
GROUP BY e.uscc_code HAVING export_shipments_to_pt > 0 ORDER BY total_fob_exported_cny DESC;"""

    q3_rows = [dict(r) for r in cur.execute("""
        SELECT e.uscc_code,
               e.company_name_en,
               e.company_name_zh,
               p.province_name_en,
               z.zone_name_en,
               e.registered_capital_wan_cny,
               ROUND(e.registered_capital_wan_cny * 10000.0, 2) AS registered_capital_cny,
               COUNT(g.gacc_entry_id_18) AS export_shipments_to_pt,
               ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(g.total_fob_value_cny), 0), 2) AS total_fob_exported_cny,
               ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.rebate_amount_paid_cny), 0), 2) AS total_vat_rebate_received_cny
        FROM cn_enterprises_manufacturers e
        JOIN cn_provinces_prefectures_cities p ON e.admin_division_code_gb = p.admin_division_code_gb
        LEFT JOIN cn_special_economic_ftz_zones z ON e.zone_id = z.zone_id
        LEFT JOIN cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc g ON e.uscc_code = g.exporter_uscc
        LEFT JOIN cn_vat_export_tax_rebates_sta r ON g.gacc_entry_id_18 = r.gacc_entry_id_18
        GROUP BY e.uscc_code
        HAVING export_shipments_to_pt > 0
        ORDER BY total_fob_exported_cny DESC;
    """).fetchall()]

    results.append({
        "query_id": "Q03",
        "scope": "Individual - David Rodrigues (China)",
        "difficulty": "Simple",
        "sources_used": [
            "Source D1: CN PostgreSQL (33_cn_provinces_prefectures_cities, 34_cn_special_economic_ftz_zones, 35_cn_enterprises_manufacturers, 44_cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc, 47_cn_vat_export_tax_rebates_sta)"
        ],
        "title": "Ranking de Exportadores Chineses para Portugal, Volume FOB (CNY) e Reembolsos Fiscais de IVA (STA Export Rebate)",
        "justification": "Query SQL sobre a fonte estruturada relacional (3FN) com JOINs entre empresas, províncias, zonas francas, declarações GACC e reembolsos fiscais STA.",
        "query_code": q3_sql,
        "output": q3_rows
    })

    # =========================================================================
    # Q4 [INTERMEDIATE - Individual David (Source D1 PostgreSQL + Source D2 XML)]
    # =========================================================================
    tree55 = ET.parse(DAVID_XML_DIR / "55_cn_master_bills_of_lading_xml.xml")
    tree64 = ET.parse(DAVID_XML_DIR / "64_cn_export_packaging_fumigation_certs_xml.xml")

    hazmat_by_bl = {}
    for cert in tree64.getroot().findall("CertificateRecord"):
        bl_no = cert.attrib["blNumber"]
        hz = cert.find("HazmatIMDGDeclaration")
        vgm = cert.find("SOLASVerifiedGrossMass")
        fum = cert.find("ISPM15WoodFumigation")
        hazmat_by_bl[bl_no] = {
            "cert_id": cert.attrib["certificateId"],
            "is_dangerous_goods": hz.attrib["isDangerousGoods"] == "true",
            "un_number": hz.attrib["unNumber"],
            "imdg_class": hz.attrib["imdgClass"],
            "ippc_fumigation_mark": fum.attrib["ippcMarkCode"],
            "vgm_kg": float(vgm.attrib["verifiedGrossMassKg"])
        }

    q4_data = []
    for bl in tree55.getroot().findall("BillOfLading"):
        bl_no = bl.attrib["blNumber"]
        gacc_id = bl.attrib["gaccDeclarationId18"]
        routing = bl.find("Routing")
        containers = bl.find("ContainerizedCargoList").findall("Container")

        sql_row = cur.execute("""
            SELECT g.gacc_entry_id_18, g.supervision_regime_code, g.total_fob_value_usd,
                   e.company_name_en, c.inspection_verdict, c.e_ciq_certificate_no
            FROM cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc g
            JOIN cn_enterprises_manufacturers e ON g.exporter_uscc = e.uscc_code
            LEFT JOIN cn_ciq_inspection_quarantine_records c ON g.gacc_entry_id_18 = c.gacc_declaration_id_18
            WHERE g.gacc_entry_id_18 = ?
        """, (gacc_id,)).fetchone()

        if sql_row:
            hz_info = hazmat_by_bl.get(bl_no, {})
            q4_data.append({
                "bl_number_xml": bl_no,
                "gacc_entry_id_sql": gacc_id,
                "exporter_cn": sql_row["company_name_en"],
                "port_of_loading_cn": routing.attrib["portOfLoading"],
                "port_of_discharge_pt": routing.attrib["portOfDischarge"],
                "vessel_imo": routing.attrib["vesselImo"],
                "containers_count": len(containers),
                "total_fob_usd": sql_row["total_fob_value_usd"],
                "ciq_quarantine_verdict": sql_row["inspection_verdict"] or "Exempt / Green Channel",
                "e_ciq_cert_no": sql_row["e_ciq_certificate_no"],
                "hazmat_un_code_xml": hz_info.get("un_number", "NON-HAZMAT"),
                "ispm15_wood_mark_xml": hz_info.get("ippc_fumigation_mark", "Standard Pallet")
            })

    results.append({
        "query_id": "Q04",
        "scope": "Individual - David Rodrigues (China)",
        "difficulty": "Intermediate",
        "sources_used": [
            "Source D1: CN PostgreSQL (35_cn_enterprises_manufacturers, 44_cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc, 46_cn_ciq_inspection_quarantine_records)",
            "Source D2: CN BaseX XML (55_cn_master_bills_of_lading_xml, 64_cn_export_packaging_fumigation_certs_xml)"
        ],
        "title": "Integração Logístico-Alfandegária na China: Declarações GACC & Quarentena CIQ (SQL) vs. e-Bills of Lading e Certificados IMDG/ISPM-15 (XML)",
        "justification": "Query intermédia que combina dados relacionais SQL (GACC e CIQ) com múltiplos contentores XML hierárquicos (Conhecimentos de Embarque e Certificados de Mercadorias Perigosas UN38.3/ISPM-15).",
        "query_code": """(: Passo 1 - XPath sobre 55_cn_master_bills_of_lading_xml.xml & 64_cn_export_packaging_fumigation_certs_xml.xml :)
//BillOfLading[@blNumber and @gaccDeclarationId18]/ContainerizedCargoList/Container
//CertificateRecord[@blNumber]/HazmatIMDGDeclaration[@unNumber='UN3480']
-- Passo 2 - Join com Fonte D1 (SQL 3FN):
SELECT g.gacc_entry_id_18, g.total_fob_value_usd, e.company_name_en, c.inspection_verdict
FROM cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc g JOIN cn_enterprises_manufacturers e ON g.exporter_uscc = e.uscc_code
LEFT JOIN cn_ciq_inspection_quarantine_records c ON g.gacc_entry_id_18 = c.gacc_declaration_id_18;""",
        "output": q4_data
    })

    # Include the 8 shared Cross-Subtopic Queries (Q05..Q12)
    local_expected = DAVID_DIR / "queries" / "expected_results_david.json"
    source_json_path = AFONSO_RESULTS if AFONSO_RESULTS.exists() else local_expected
    if source_json_path.exists():
        afonso_q = json.loads(source_json_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        for q in afonso_q:
            if q["query_id"] not in ("Q01", "Q02", "Q03", "Q04"):
                results.append(q)

    out_path = DAVID_DIR / "queries" / "expected_results_david.json"
    out_path.write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    conn.close()

    if not quiet:
        print("=" * 116)
        print("🇨🇳 CADERNO DE QUERIES DE DAVID RODRIGUES (SUBTÓPICO CHINA — 58 ENTIDADES: 38 SQL 3FN + 20 XML/XSD)")
        print("   Inclui as Queries Individuais (Q03, Q04) e as 8 Queries Cruzadas com Portugal (Q05 a Q12)")
        print("=" * 116)
        for q in results:
            print_query_execution(q)
        print("\n" + "=" * 116)
        print(f"✅ [SUCESSO] {len(results)} queries executadas, código exibido e tabelas de dados reais impressas!")
        print(f"💾 Ficheiro JSON de resultados atualizado em: {out_path}")
        print("=" * 116)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    quiet_flag = "--quiet" in sys.argv
    run_david_queries(quiet=quiet_flag)

code_files.title: David: DDL das 6 Vistas SQL 3FN da China (GACC / SAFE / CBAM)
code_files.desc: Define as 6 Vistas SQL relacionais sobre a base 3FN da China para visualização imediata em DBeaver, pgAdmin ou DB Browser for SQLite.
code_files.content:
-- =============================================================================
-- UNIVERSIDADE DO ALGARVE - Mestrado em Engenharia Informática (2026/2027)
-- Modelação e Integração de Dados (DMI) - Projeto P1
-- Subtópico China: Vistas SQL Relacionais (Views em 3.ª Forma Normal)
-- Autor: David Rodrigues
-- =============================================================================

-- 1. Vista de Desalfandegamento Aduaneiro de Exportação da China para Portugal
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_desalfandegamento_exportacao_china;
CREATE VIEW vw_desalfandegamento_exportacao_china AS
SELECT 
    d.gacc_entry_id_18,
    date(d.declaration_date_epoch, 'unixepoch') AS data_declaracao,
    e.company_name_zh AS exportador_nome_zh,
    e.company_name_en AS exportador_nome_en,
    d.exporter_uscc,
    i.buyer_pt_eori,
    d.customs_port_code_cn,
    d.port_of_discharge_unlocode,
    d.transport_mode_code,
    d.vessel_imo_or_train_no,
    d.supervision_regime_code,
    d.clearance_channel,
    d.total_fob_value_cny,
    d.total_fob_value_usd,
    i.total_invoice_value,
    i.invoice_currency,
    COALESCE(r.rebate_amount_paid_cny, 0) AS reembolso_iva_sta_cny,
    COALESCE(r.sta_approval_status, 'NÃO_SUBMETIDO') AS estado_reembolso_iva
FROM cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc d
JOIN cn_enterprises_manufacturers e ON d.exporter_uscc = e.uscc_code
JOIN cn_commercial_invoices i ON d.invoice_no = i.invoice_no
LEFT JOIN cn_vat_export_tax_rebates_sta r ON d.gacc_entry_id_18 = r.gacc_entry_id_18;

-- 2. Vista da Balança Comercial Bilateral (Fluxo Exportação China -> PT e Importação China <- PT)
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_balanca_comercial_bilateral_cn_pt;
CREATE VIEW vw_balanca_comercial_bilateral_cn_pt AS
SELECT 
    'EXPORT_CN_TO_PT' AS fluxo_direcao,
    d.gacc_entry_id_18 AS id_declaracao,
    date(d.declaration_date_epoch, 'unixepoch') AS data_operacao,
    d.exporter_uscc AS operador_origem,
    e.company_name_en AS operador_origem_nome,
    i.buyer_pt_eori AS operador_destino,
    d.port_of_discharge_unlocode AS porto_destino,
    d.total_fob_value_usd AS valor_fob_usd,
    d.total_fob_value_cny AS valor_cny,
    d.clearance_channel AS canal_despacho
FROM cn_customs_export_declarations_gacc d
JOIN cn_enterprises_manufacturers e ON d.exporter_uscc = e.uscc_code
JOIN cn_commercial_invoices i ON d.invoice_no = i.invoice_no

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    'IMPORT_CN_FROM_PT' AS fluxo_direcao,
    imp.gacc_import_id_18 AS id_declaracao,
    imp.declaration_date AS data_operacao,
    imp.portuguese_exporter_nif_eori AS operador_origem,
    'Exportador Nacional (Vinho/Cortiça/Azeite)' AS operador_origem_nome,
    imp.importer_cn_uscc AS operador_destino,
    imp.customs_entry_port_cn AS porto_destino,
    ROUND(imp.cif_value_cny / 7.22, 2) AS valor_fob_usd,
    imp.cif_value_cny AS valor_cny,
    'GREEN_CUSTOMS_CLEARANCE' AS canal_despacho
FROM cn_customs_import_declarations_gacc imp;

-- 3. Vista de Inspeções Sanitárias e Fitossanitárias CIQ/GACC e Conformidade CIFER
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_inspecoes_sanitarias_ciq_cifer;
CREATE VIEW vw_inspecoes_sanitarias_ciq_cifer AS
SELECT 
    ciq.ciq_inspection_id,
    ciq.gacc_declaration_id_18,
    ciq.inspection_direction,
    ciq.ciq_bureau_branch,
    ciq.sample_lab_test_code,
    ciq.pesticide_or_heavy_metal_ppm,
    CASE WHEN ciq.wood_packaging_ispm15_compliant = 1 THEN 'CONFORME_ISPM15' ELSE 'NÃO_CONFORME' END AS embalagem_madeira_ispm15,
    CASE WHEN ciq.chinese_labeling_compliant = 1 THEN 'ROTULAGEM_CONFORME' ELSE 'ROTULAGEM_IRREGULAR' END AS rotulagem_mandarim_gacc,
    ciq.e_ciq_certificate_no,
    ciq.inspection_verdict
FROM cn_ciq_inspection_quarantine_records ciq;

-- 4. Vista de Liquidação Cambial Bancária Transfronteiriça PBOC/SAFE (SWIFT & CIPS)
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_liquidacao_cambial_forex_safe;
CREATE VIEW vw_liquidacao_cambial_forex_safe AS
SELECT 
    fx.safe_verification_no,
    fx.swift_uetr_or_cips_id,
    fx.invoice_no,
    ent.company_name_en AS empresa_chinesa_nome,
    fx.chinese_entity_uscc,
    fx.portuguese_entity_nif,
    fx.chinese_bank_name,
    fx.settlement_channel,
    fx.original_currency,
    fx.settled_foreign_amount,
    fx.settled_rmb_cny_amount,
    fx.pboc_central_parity_rate,
    fx.settlement_date
FROM cn_fx_settlements_pboc_safe fx
JOIN cn_enterprises_manufacturers ent ON fx.chinese_entity_uscc = ent.uscc_code;

-- 5. Vista de Operadores Económicos Chineses AEO e Acordo de Reconhecimento Mútuo MRA com a UE
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_operadores_economicos_aeo_confianca;
CREATE VIEW vw_operadores_economicos_aeo_confianca AS
SELECT 
    ent.uscc_code,
    ent.customs_cr_code_10,
    ent.company_name_zh,
    ent.company_name_en,
    ent.ownership_type,
    ent.aeo_customs_tier,
    ent.registered_capital_wan_cny,
    COALESCE(mra.aeo_mra_certificate_no, 'NÃO_APLICÁVEL') AS certificado_mra_eu_pt,
    COALESCE(mra.eu_partner_eori_pt, '-') AS parceiro_pt_privilegiado,
    COALESCE(mra.reduced_inspection_rate_pct, 0) AS taxa_inspecao_reduzida_pct,
    COALESCE(mra.priority_clearance_lane, 0) AS canal_verde_prioritario
FROM cn_enterprises_manufacturers ent
LEFT JOIN cn_gacc_aeo_mutual_recognition_registry mra ON ent.uscc_code = mra.chinese_enterprise_uscc;

-- 6. Vista de Auditorias Industriais ESG e Descarbonização CBAM
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_auditoria_esg_cbam_descarbonizacao;
CREATE VIEW vw_auditoria_esg_cbam_descarbonizacao AS
SELECT 
    audit.audit_record_id,
    fac.facility_name,
    ent.company_name_en AS empresa_titular,
    audit.reporting_year,
    audit.annual_renewable_power_mwh,
    audit.annual_coal_power_mwh,
    ROUND((audit.annual_renewable_power_mwh * 100.0) / (audit.annual_renewable_power_mwh + audit.annual_coal_power_mwh), 1) AS percentagem_energia_verde,
    audit.scope1_direct_emissions_tco2,
    audit.scope2_indirect_emissions_tco2,
    audit.carbon_tax_paid_in_china_cny_per_ton,
    audit.verified_by_cnas_body
FROM cn_green_manufacturing_esg_audits audit
JOIN cn_factory_production_facilities fac ON audit.facility_id = fac.facility_id
JOIN cn_enterprises_manufacturers ent ON fac.uscc_code = ent.uscc_code;

code_files.title: David: Script de Auditoria e Verificação Autónoma da China
code_files.desc: Audita as 38 tabelas 3FN com PRAGMA foreign_key_check, valida os 20 XMLs contra o XSD via xmllint e executa o caderno de queries da China.
code_files.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# UNIVERSIDADE DO ALGARVE - Mestrado em Engenharia Informática (2026/2027)
# Unidade Curricular: Modelação e Integração de Dados (DMI) - Projeto P1
# Script de Verificação e Demonstração Real — David Rodrigues (Subtópico China)
# =============================================================================

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

echo "===================================================================================================================="
echo "🇨🇳 VERIFICAÇÃO E AUDITORIA REAL DA ENTREGA — DAVID RODRIGUES (SUBTÓPICO CHINA — 58 ENTIDADES)"
echo "===================================================================================================================="

# 1. Pastas e Relatórios PDF
echo ""
echo "▶ [TESTE 1/4] ESTRUTURA DO PACOTE E RELATÓRIOS TÉCNICOS EM PDF (SECÇÃO 6.1)"
echo "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────"
for item in "report" "src" "data" "database" "models" "queries" "README.md" "AI_DECLARATION.md"; do
  if [ ! -e "$item" ]; then
    echo "❌ FALTANDO: $item"
    exit 1
  fi
done
ls -lh report/*.pdf README.md AI_DECLARATION.md
echo "✅ Estrutura de pastas e relatórios PDF oficiais verificados!"

# 2. Auditoria Real das 38 Tabelas Relacionais em 3FN (PostgreSQL / SQLite)
echo ""
echo "▶ [TESTE 2/4] AUDITORIA REAL DAS 38 TABELAS RELACIONAIS EM 3.ª FORMA NORMAL (FONTE D1)"
echo "────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────"
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("data/relational_db/china_gacc_mofcom_3nf.sqlite")
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check;")
fk_errs = cur.fetchall()
assert len(fk_errs) == 0, f"Violações FK: {fk_errs}"

tables = [r[0] for r in cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name").fetchall()]
assert len(tables) == 38, f"Esperadas 38 tabelas 3FN, encontradas {len(tables)}"

print("  ┌────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬──────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┐")
print("  │ #  │ Nome da Tabela SQL (3.ª Forma Normal)                  │ Registos │ Exemplo de Chave Primária Real         │")
print("  ├────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────┼────────────────────────────────────────┤")
total_rows = 0
for idx, t in enumerate(tables, 1):
    cnt = cur.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {t}").fetchone()[0]
    total_rows += cnt
    first_row = cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {t} LIMIT 1").fetchone()
    pk_sample = first_row[0] if first_row else "-"
    print(f"  │ {idx:2d} │ {t[:54]:<54} │ {cnt:8d} │ {str(pk_sample)[:38]:<38} │")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
===============================================================================
UNIVERSIDADE DO ALGARVE - Mestrado em Engenharia Informática (2026/2027)
Unidade Curricular: Modelação e Integração de Dados (DMI) - Projeto P1
Docente Coordenadora: Prof.ª Doutora Paula Cristina Negrão Ventura Martins
Autores: Afonso Bitoque (Portugal) & David Rodrigues (China)
Script: run_all_queries.py
Descrição:
  Executa, exibe o código de cada consulta (MongoDB / SQL 3FN / XPath) e
  imprime no terminal as tabelas formatadas com os resultados reais das
  12 Queries Obrigatórias do Projeto P1 (Q01 a Q12).
===============================================================================
"""

import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any

ROOT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
AFONSO_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "Afonso_Bitoque_Portugal"
DAVID_DIR = ROOT_DIR / "David_Rodrigues_China"


def format_ascii_table(rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], max_col_width: int = 28, max_rows: int = 12) -> str:
    if not rows:
        return "  (Sem registos devolvidos)\n"
    display_rows = rows[:max_rows]
    headers = list(display_rows[0].keys())
    if len(headers) > 7:
        headers = headers[:7]

    def fmt_val(v):
        if v is None:
            return "NULL"
        if isinstance(v, float):
            return f"{v:,.2f}"
        s = str(v).replace("\n", " ")
        return s[:max_col_width - 1] + "…" if len(s) > max_col_width else s

    widths = [len(h) for h in headers]
    str_rows = []
    for r in display_rows:
        sr = [fmt_val(r.get(h)) for h in headers]
        for idx, val in enumerate(sr):
            if len(val) > widths[idx]:
                widths[idx] = len(val)
        str_rows.append(sr)

    top = "  ┌─" + "─┬─".join("─" * w for w in widths) + "─┐"
    head = "  │ " + " │ ".join(h.ljust(widths[i]) for i, h in enumerate(headers)) + " │"
    sep = "  ├─" + "─┼─".join("─" * w for w in widths) + "─┤"
    bot = "  └─" + "─┴─".join("─" * w for w in widths) + "─┘"

    lines = [top, head, sep]
    for sr in str_rows:
        lines.append("  │ " + " │ ".join(sr[i].ljust(widths[i]) for i in range(len(headers))) + " │")
    lines.append(bot)
    if len(rows) > max_rows:
        lines.append(f"  ... (+{len(rows) - max_rows} registos adicionais omitidos no ecrã; todos gravados no JSON)")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    print("=" * 116)
    print("🚀 EXECUTANDO AS 12 QUERIES OBRIGATÓRIAS DO PROJETO P1 (DMI 2026/2027 — 116 ENTIDADES)")
    print("   Subtópico Portugal (58 Entidades): Afonso Bitoque | Subtópico China (58 Entidades): David Rodrigues")
    print("=" * 116)

    t0 = time.time()

    # 1. Execute Afonso's Suite (Q01, Q02 + Q05..Q12)
    afonso_script = AFONSO_DIR / "queries" / "run_afonso_queries.py"
    res1 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(afonso_script), "--quiet"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res1.returncode != 0:
        print("❌ Erro ao executar a suite do Afonso:")
        print(res1.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    # 2. Execute David's Suite (Q03, Q04)
    david_script = DAVID_DIR / "queries" / "run_david_queries.py"
    res2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(david_script), "--quiet"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res2.returncode != 0:
        print("❌ Erro ao executar a suite do David:")
        print(res2.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    # 3. Load Results
    afonso_json = json.loads((AFONSO_DIR / "queries" / "expected_results_afonso.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    david_json = json.loads((DAVID_DIR / "queries" / "expected_results_david.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    q_map = {}
    for q in afonso_json:
        q_map[q["query_id"]] = q
    for q in david_json:
        q_map[q["query_id"]] = q

    sorted_ids = [f"Q{i:02d}" for i in range(1, 13)]
    consolidated = []

    diff_labels = {
        "Simple": "Simples",
        "Intermediate": "Intermédia",
        "Complex": "Complexa"
    }

    owners = {
        "Q01": "Afonso Bitoque (Portugal)",
        "Q02": "Afonso Bitoque (Portugal)",
        "Q03": "David Rodrigues (China)",
        "Q04": "David Rodrigues (China)",
        "Q05": "Afonso Bitoque & David Rodrigues",
        "Q06": "Afonso Bitoque & David Rodrigues",
        "Q07": "Afonso Bitoque & David Rodrigues",
        "Q08": "Afonso Bitoque & David Rodrigues",
        "Q09": "Afonso Bitoque & David Rodrigues",
        "Q10": "Afonso Bitoque & David Rodrigues",
        "Q11": "Afonso Bitoque & David Rodrigues",
        "Q12": "Afonso Bitoque & David Rodrigues"
    }

    for qid in sorted_ids:
        q = q_map.get(qid)
        if not q:
            continue
        q["responsible"] = owners.get(qid, "Grupo DMI")
        q["difficulty_pt"] = diff_labels.get(q["difficulty"], q["difficulty"])
        output_len = len(q.get("output", [])) if isinstance(q.get("output"), list) else 1
        q["records_returned"] = output_len
        consolidated.append(q)

        print("\n" + "━" * 116)
        print(f"🔎 [{q['query_id']}] [{q['difficulty_pt'].upper()}] — {q['title']}")
        print(f"👤 Responsável: {q['responsible']}   |   🗄️ Fontes: {', '.join(q.get('sources_used', []))}")
        print(f"💡 Justificação: {q['justification']}")
        print("─" * 116)
        print("📜 CÓDIGO DA QUERY EXECUTADA:")
        for line in q.get("query_code", "").strip().split("\n"):
            print(f"   {line}")
        print("─" * 116)
        print(f"📊 RESULTADOS REAIS OBTIDOS ({output_len} registos):")
        print(format_ascii_table(q.get("output", [])))

    # 4. Print Summary Matrix
    print("\n" + "=" * 116)
    print("📋 MATRIZ RESUMO DAS 12 QUERIES EXECUTADAS")
    print("=" * 116)
    print(f"{'ID':<5} | {'Dificuldade':<12} | {'Registos':<8} | {'Responsável':<32} | {'Título'}")
    print("-" * 116)
    for q in consolidated:
        print(f"{q['query_id']:<5} | {q['difficulty_pt']:<12} | {q['records_returned']:<8} | {q['responsible']:<32} | {q['title'][:50]}")

    out_file = ROOT_DIR / "queries" / "expected_results_all_12_queries.json"
    out_file.write_text(json.dumps(consolidated, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")

    total_time = round((time.time() - t0) * 1000, 2)
    print("=" * 116)
    print(f"🎉 [SUCESSO] Total de {len(consolidated)}/12 queries executadas, impressas e verificadas em {total_time} ms!")
    print(f"📊 Distribuição de Dificuldade: 4 Simples (Q1,Q3,Q5,Q6), 4 Intermédias (Q2,Q4,Q7,Q8), 4 Complexas (Q9,Q10,Q11,Q12)")
    print(f"💾 Resultados consolidados gravados em: {out_file}\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
=============================================================================
UNIVERSIDADE DO ALGARVE - Mestrado em Engenharia Informática (2026/2027)
Modelação e Integração de Dados (DMI) - Projeto P1
Script de Demonstração e Visualização de VISTAS (SQL Views)
Autores: Afonso Bitoque (Portugal) & David Rodrigues (China)
=============================================================================
Permite inspecionar as Vistas das bases de dados em modo tabular no terminal,
ou preparar a demonstração para a professora em software tradicional
(DBeaver, DB Browser for SQLite, MongoDB Compass, VS Code).
=============================================================================
"""

import sys
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

CHINA_DB = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "David_Rodrigues_China/data/relational_db/china_gacc_mofcom_3nf.sqlite"
PORTUGAL_DB = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "Afonso_Bitoque_Portugal/data/ai_structured_output/afonso_ai_structured_warehouse.sqlite"

def format_ascii_table(rows, headers, max_col_width=32):
    if not rows:
        return "  (Sem registos a apresentar)"
    col_widths = [len(h) for h in headers]
    for r in rows:
        for i, val in enumerate(r):
            s = str(val if val is not None else "-")
            col_widths[i] = max(col_widths[i], min(len(s), max_col_width))

    sep_top = "  ┌─" + "─┬─".join("─" * w for w in col_widths) + "─┐"
    sep_mid = "  ├─" + "─┼─".join("─" * w for w in col_widths) + "─┤"
    sep_bot = "  └─" + "─┴─".join("─" * w for w in col_widths) + "─┘"

    header_line = "  │ " + " │ ".join(f"{h[:w]:<{w}}" for h, w in zip(headers, col_widths)) + " │"
    out_lines = [sep_top, header_line, sep_mid]

    for r in rows:
        cells = []
        for val, w in zip(r, col_widths):
            s = str(val if val is not None else "-")
            if len(s) > w:
                s = s[:w - 1] + "…"
            cells.append(f"{s:<{w}}")
        out_lines.append("  │ " + " │ ".join(cells) + " │")
    out_lines.append(sep_bot)
    return "\n".join(out_lines)

def list_and_show_views(target_view=None, limit=10):
    print("=" * 115)
    print("📊 VISTAS SQL (DATABASE VIEWS) DISPONÍVEIS PARA DEMONSTRAÇÃO E SOFTWARE TRADICIONAL")
    print("=" * 115)

    databases = [
        ("🇨🇳 SUBTÓPICO CHINA — David Rodrigues (Relacional 3FN / SQLite)", CHINA_DB),
        ("🇵🇹 SUBTÓPICO PORTUGAL — Afonso Bitoque (Warehouse IA / SQLite)", PORTUGAL_DB),
    ]

    found_any = False
    for db_title, db_path in databases:
        if not db_path.exists():
            print(f"❌ Base de dados não encontrada: {db_path}")
            continue

        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        cur = conn.cursor()
        views = [r[0] for r in cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='view' ORDER BY name").fetchall()]

        print(f"\n📂 {db_title}")
        print(f"   Ficheiro: {db_path}")
        print(f"   Total de Vistas Ativas: {len(views)}")
        print("   " + "─" * 105)

        for idx, v in enumerate(views, 1):
            cur.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {v}")
            cnt = cur.fetchone()[0]

            cur.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({v})")
            cols = [c[1] for c in cur.fetchall()]

            print(f"   [{idx:02d}] 👁️  {v:<45} │ {cnt:4d} registos │ {len(cols):2d} colunas: ({', '.join(cols[:4])}...)")

            if target_view and (target_view.lower() == "all" or target_view.lower() == v.lower()):
                found_any = True
                cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {v} LIMIT {limit}")
                rows = cur.fetchall()
                print(f"\n      🔎 AMOSTRA DA VISTA '{v}' ({min(len(rows), limit)} de {cnt} registos):")
                print(format_ascii_table(rows, cols, max_col_width=28))
                print()

        conn.close()

    print("\n" + "=" * 115)
    print("💡 COMO MOSTRAR ESTAS VISTAS À PROFESSORA EM SOFTWARE TRADICIONAL:")
    print("=" * 115)
    print("1. 🗄️  DB BROWSER FOR SQLITE (Recomendado para SQLite):")
    print("   - Abrir o DB Browser -> 'Abrir Base de Dados' -> Escolher:")
    print(f"     • {CHINA_DB}")
    print(f"     • {PORTUGAL_DB}")
    print("   - Clicar na pasta 'Views' ou no separador 'Navegar Dados' -> Selecionar qualquer vista no dropdown!")
    print("")
    print("2. 🐬 DBEAVER COMMUNITY (Universal Database Tool):")
    print("   - 'Nova Ligação' -> SQLite -> Apontar para os ficheiros .sqlite acima.")
    print("   - Expandir a árvore: Databases -> Views -> Duplo clique em qualquer vista para ver a grelha de dados!")
    print("")
    print("3. 🍃 MONGODB COMPASS (Para a Base NoSQL de Portugal):")
    print("   - Carregar as 39 coleções e correr no terminal: mongosh pt_comercio_internacional database/mongo_create_views.js")
    print("   - No Compass, as vistas aparecem no menu lateral esquerdo com um ícone de 'Olho'!")
    print("")
    print("4. 💻 VISUAL STUDIO CODE / ANTIGRAVITY IDE:")
    print("   - Com a extensão 'SQLite Viewer', basta clicar nos ficheiros .sqlite no explorador de ficheiros!")
    print("=" * 115)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    arg = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
    list_and_show_views(target_view=arg)
